theme.title: Warriors from deep
theme.subtitle: Golden State shooting records
theme.recap: Golden State's shooters broke records for threes in a game, threes in a playoff game and threes in consecutive games.

questions.prompt: On November 7, 2016, Stephen Curry set what was then the single-game record for threes. How many did he make?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Stephen Curry set a new record of 13 three-pointers made in a single game

funFacts.text: Curry's famous rebound night came immediately after his long made-three streak ended against the Lakers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: After having his streak of consecutive games with a three-pointer come to an end the previous game

funFacts.text: The superteam season began with a surprisingly heavy home defeat against Kawhi Leonard's Spurs.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: with a 29-point home loss to the San Antonio Spurs

funFacts.text: Kevin Durant's arrival brought Golden State another superstar alongside Curry, Thompson and Green.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: forming a new All-Star "Fantastic Four" of Kevin Durant, Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson and Draymond Green

questions.prompt: Klay Thompson scored 60 points against Indiana on December 5, 2016. How many minutes did he play?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: scored 60 points in 29 minutes against the Indiana Pacers on December 5, 2016

funFacts.text: Thompson had earlier beaten his own Splash Brother, Stephen Curry, in the All-Star three-point contest.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Klay Thompson won the Three-Point Contest at the All-Star weekend, beating Stephen Curry

funFacts.text: Thompson, Durant and Green all brought Olympic gold medals back to the Warriors that same summer.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Kevin Durant, Klay Thompson and Draymond Green joined Chris Mullin

funFacts.text: The huge performance placed Klay alongside historic Golden State scorers Wilt Chamberlain and Rick Barry.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He joins Wilt Chamberlain, Steph Curry, Rick Barry, and Joe Fulks

questions.prompt: Facing elimination at Oklahoma City in 2016, Klay Thompson set what was then the playoff record for threes. How many?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Klay Thompson made eleven three-pointers, breaking the NBA playoff record of nine.

funFacts.text: Golden State was facing elimination after the Thunder had built a commanding series lead.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: putting them down 1–3 in the Western Conference finals

funFacts.text: All three of Curry, Thompson and Green were named All-NBA during the tense Oklahoma City series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Stephen Curry, Draymond Green and Klay Thompson were named to the 2015–16 All-NBA Team

funFacts.text: The Warriors rallied to take the deciding game, but would later lose a Finals series after leading Cleveland.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: they defeated the Thunder 96–88

questions.prompt: Stephen Curry’s streak of regular-season games with a made three ended in November 2016. How many games did it last?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Most consecutive regular-season games with a made three-pointer: 157

funFacts.text: The streak stopped in Los Angeles when Curry couldn't make an outside shot against the Lakers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: against the Los Angeles Lakers, with Curry going 0 for 10 from three-point range

funFacts.text: Kyle Korver had held the previous regular-season made-three streak record.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: previous record of 127 held by Kyle Korver

funFacts.text: Across regular-season and playoff games combined, Curry had also set a separate longer made-three streak.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Most consecutive games (regular-season and postseason combined) with a made three-pointer

questions.prompt: On March 25, 2016, the Warriors and Mavericks set a record for combined threes in a game. How many?
questions.note: 39: 21 by Golden State, 18 by Dallas. A record at the time.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: both teams combined for 39 made three-pointers (21 by the Warriors, 18 by the Mavericks), an all-time NBA record,

funFacts.text: Golden State became the first NBA team to sink a thousand three-pointers in a single regular season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the first team in league history to hit 1,000 three-pointers in a single season

funFacts.text: Assistant coach Luke Walton ran the Warriors early in the year while Steve Kerr recovered from back trouble.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: assistant coach Luke Walton coaching for the team after it was confirmed that coach Steve Kerr's back would not heal

funFacts.text: Draymond Green recorded a rare five-by-five stat line during an overtime trip to Boston.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Draymond Green recorded a five-by-five game
